exploits.title: Withdraw door has NO ride-eligibility gate TODAY — coins minted with zero rides cash out 1:1
exploits.howItDrains: VERIFIED in coinService.ts:110 — withdraw() gates ONLY on type==='client' && phone present. There is NO member.trips>0 check. Every coin-mint path pays a fresh account WITHOUT a ride: referral referee 2000 + referrer 3000 (referralService.ts:99-103), free mystery box (~600-2500 coins, unlocks when daily missions done — and daily_checkin + daily_spin complete cost-free, boxService.ts:33/getBoxStatus), daily wheel free spin, streak, and daily missions all grantCoins (mission/wheel/box/streak/referral are coins, confirmed grantCoins not grantCashback). A fresh phone-linked fake account nets ~5,000-7,000 coins on day one with ZERO paid rides, all of it WITHDRAWABLE 1:1 to real kas bonus. Design pillar 5 itself flags this as 'currently MISSING ... a farm of 100 throwaway Telegram accounts = 5M/day extractable' — but it is a PROPOSAL, not in the code. Real drain today is bounded only by the global withdraw budget (~69.5k so'm/day at 165 rides), which a single farm exhausts entirely, starving real users and draining ~69.5k/day of real money to fakes.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: ~69.5k so'm/day (entire global withdraw budget captured by fakes) until budget is exhausted; the per-account 50k cap is irrelevant because 2 fake accounts already exceed the whole pool
exploits.fix: SHIP Wall 3 BEFORE any of this: add `if ((member.trips ?? 0) < 1) return fail('no_ride')` at coinService.ts:110. trips already exists on Member (synced from kas). This is the single highest-leverage line and it is NOT in the code yet — it must land in Phase 0, today, before booking-speedup or transfer/market amplify the funnel.

exploits.title: Sybil referral farm: no phone-identity self-deal guard, 5000 coins minted per fake invitee
exploits.howItDrains: VERIFIED in referralService.ts:67/91 — self-invite is blocked ONLY by `referrer.id === refereeTelegramId` (Telegram ID equality). There is NO phone-identity or device check. One operator with N burner Telegram accounts + N SIM/virtual numbers that resolve as kas clients invites themselves N times: each completeReferral mints 2000 (referee) + 3000 (referrer) = 5000 coins, plus weekly_invite mission (3000 coins, mission reward) for the referrer. completeReferral only requires the referee to linkByPhone — NO ride needed. Combined with exploit #1 (no withdraw ride-gate), every 5000 minted coins becomes 5000 so'm real. reconciliation.ts only flags single-account 24h gain ≥80k (ANOMALY_24H_GAIN) and per-member drift — it does NOT detect a ring of many small accounts each gaining 5k.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: Mint side unbounded (5k coins × number of fake accounts); real-money side still capped by the ~69.5k global withdraw budget — but the farm captures 100% of it, and the minted-coin overhang persists across days, draining the budget every day until detected
exploits.fix: (1) Ride-gate the withdraw door (exploit #1) makes minted referral coins non-cashable until each account takes a real paid ride. (2) Add a phone/device de-dup on referral payout: skip referrer reward if referee phone shares last-9 digits with an existing referee of the same referrer, or if device fingerprint repeats. (3) Make referrer reward contingent on the referee completing ≥1 ride (referralService completeReferral should defer the referrer 3000 until referee.trips>0), turning referral from a mint into a real-acquisition reward. (4) Add ring/fan-in detection to reconciliationWatch (≥5 fresh referees → 1 referrer same week → riskFlag).

exploits.title: P2P transfer funnel concentrates farm coins into ride-eligible mules (amplifies #1/#2)
exploits.howItDrains: The transfer rail (pillar 2/5) lets coins move between members. Even with the proposed two-sided 30k caps, a farm minting 5k/account across 100 fake accounts can funnel coins toward the few accounts that DID take a real ride (and so pass the ride-gate), concentrating extraction. The designs claim two-sided caps make funneling give 'zero extra withdraw capacity' — TRUE only IF receive-cap < withdraw-cap AND the global budget binds. But note: the proposed receive cap (30k) is LOWER than the per-member withdraw cap (50k), so a mule can absorb 30k/day from mints it didn't earn and withdraw it (still ride-gated). Without the burn + ride-gate + receive-cap ALL shipped together, transfer is a laundering pump that turns scattered un-cashable mints into cashable concentration. reconciliation is invariant-safe (paired txns) so the money-integrity watch will NOT flag this — it sees no drift.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: No NEW real money beyond the global budget IF the ride-gate + receive-cap + 2% burn all ship; but if transfer ships before the ride-gate (exploit #1), it directly enlarges daily extraction to the full ~69.5k budget concentrated through clean mules, every day
exploits.fix: Do NOT ship transfer until the withdraw ride-gate (#1) is live. Then enforce, atomically in one $transaction: two-sided caps (sent 30k AND received 30k/day), ≤5 distinct counterparties/day, 48h account-age gate (TelegramUser.linkedAt), A→B→A ring-detect, and the 2% burn (destroy coins, shrinking supply). Tips exempt from counterparty-COUNT only, never from the received-cap. alertAdmins on any transfer ≥10k and every ring hit.

exploits.title: Driver-client collusion via tips + driver_bonus + driver cash-out (real money, budget-shared but new surface)
exploits.howItDrains: Driver wallet (pillar 2) credits tips (P2P-in), per-trip driver_bonus (~300 coin), and generalizes withdraw() so DRIVERS can cash out. Collusion: a driver colludes with N rider accounts. Each rider books a real (or barely-real) ride, then tips the driver via the 1-tap 'Rahmat' buttons (1000/2000/5000). Driver accumulates tips + driver_bonus, then withdraws. Because kas is taximeter/pickup-only with no fixed fare and no kas driver-balance write API (confirmed kas/client.ts mapDriver read-only), the per-trip driver_bonus is funded by US, not the fare — so every completed (even ultra-short) ride mints 300 coins to the driver that we owe as real money via the budget. driver_bonus needs a carNumber→driverMember lookup that does NOT exist yet (bookingNotifier matches by RIDER phone) — so if mis-joined, bonus could pay the wrong account or double-pay on sync replay if idempotency key isn't strictly kasBookingId. Driver cash-out branch A2 (no kas client record) creates an admin-settled Withdrawal queue — a manual real-money path that, if not budget-gated identically, escapes the revenue cap.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: Tips are closed-loop (rider's own coins move to driver — net-zero mint, capped by rider's mintable balance which is itself ride-gated). The NEW mint is driver_bonus: 300 coin × fake completed trips. At, say, 200 collusive short trips/day = 60k coins/day minted to one driver — but real exit still capped by the shared ~69.5k global budget IF driver withdraw calls consumeWithdrawBudget FIRST. If A2 admin-settled path skips the budget, loss is unbounded by the queue size
exploits.fix: (1) Defer driver_bonus to Phase 3 as the design says; when shipped, idempotency key = kas booking id (prevents sync-replay double-pay), daily driver earn cap (20k), and bonus ≤ proven net profit/order. (2) driver_bonus only on rides with status=completed AND a real fare signal, not merely dispatched. (3) BOTH driver cash-out branches (A1 kas-write AND A2 admin-queue) MUST call consumeWithdrawBudget(amount) FIRST — the A2 manual queue is the dangerous one; never let admin settlement bypass the revenue budget. (4) Tips: cap daily-RECEIVED per driver (30k) so a tip-mule ring can't over-concentrate; tips stay exempt from counterparty-count only.

exploits.title: Fake-shop / wash-trade REDEEM marketplace drains real money at the spread (Phase 2 cash path)
exploits.howItDrains: Bozor REDEEM mode (pillar 3) cash-settles a shop owner at coins×(1−spread) via addClientBonus(shopOwnerPhone) under a NEW consumeBozorBudget. Collusion: operator registers a fake/complicit shop (manual KYC is the only barrier), lists a REDEEM item, then has farm/rider accounts 'buy' it (spendCoins burns buyer coins) and 'redeem' the voucher. On redeem the shop accrues coins×(1−0.12)=88% of face as REAL money. The buyer coins are themselves ride-gated mints (#1), but the shop now extracts 88% of every wash purchase as cash from the bozor budget. ABSORB-only for new shops (trustTier 0) correctly costs 0 — the risk is ENTIRELY in the REDEEM promotion: once a shop is promoted, a wash ring round-trips farm coins → 88% cash. The escrow design (shop paid only on coded redemption the buyer presents) does NOT stop collusion because the colluding buyer willingly presents the code. Self-deal guard (buyerMemberId===ownerMemberId / same phone) blocks the trivial case but NOT a ring of distinct mule buyers.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: Bounded by Shop.dailyCap (default 500,000) × spread-retained AND the consumeBozorBudget pool (BASE + rides×PER_RIDE). With dailyCap 500k and 88% settle, one promoted fake shop drains up to ~440k/day of real money IF the bozor budget allows — the bozor budget is the real ceiling, but dailyCap 500k is far too loose relative to it
exploits.fix: (1) Keep MVP ABSORB-only (0 cash risk) — do NOT ship REDEEM until consumeBozorBudget is wired AND tested. (2) Lower default Shop.dailyCap to a small multiple of the shop's own ride/revenue contribution, not a flat 500k. (3) Trust ladder: REDEEM is the LAST privilege, granted only after a clean ABSORB track record + manual admin review of each settlement. (4) Spread-bleed (every wash round-trip loses 12%) plus velocity cap (per-buyer→per-shop/day) plus fan-in detection (≥5 fresh buyers → 1 shop) → settlement-hold + alertAdmins before any cash leaves. (5) Hold settlement (defer payout) on any anomalous shop — mirror reconciliation detect→freeze→alert.

exploits.title: Free mystery box unlocks with zero-cost daily missions — a daily no-ride coin mint feeding the withdraw door
exploits.howItDrains: VERIFIED boxService.ts:33-40 — the free box unlocks when ALL daily missions are complete (dailiesDone===dailiesTotal). Several daily missions complete with NO ride and NO spend: daily_checkin (just tap), daily_spin (free daily spin). If the arcade missions (daily_race/daily_quiz) are purged per pillar 4 and the remaining dailies are checkin/spin/ride, then a no-ride account can't complete daily_ride — but if the daily set is ever all-free (or partially gated), the free box mints ~600-2500 coins/day per account with zero economic contribution. Across a sybil farm this is a recurring daily mint that, absent the withdraw ride-gate (#1), is fully cashable.
exploits.maxLossPerDay: ~2,500 coins/account/day mint; cashable portion bounded by the global withdraw budget (~69.5k/day) shared across the farm
exploits.fix: (1) The withdraw ride-gate (#1) neutralizes this entirely — minted box coins can't exit without a real ride. (2) Ensure at least one daily mission in the unlock set REQUIRES a completed paid ride (keep daily_ride in the free-box unlock requirement), so the daily free box is itself ride-anchored — aligns with the strategy's ride-linked habit loop. (3) Keep box mints as coins (already true), never grantCashback.

requiredGuards: SHIP FIRST (Phase 0, today): withdraw ride-eligibility gate — coinService.ts:110 must reject members with trips<1 (reason 'no_ride'). This is the single load-bearing guard and it is NOT in the code yet. Every other 'economicSafety' claim in all 5 pillars depends on it; without it the global budget is fully drainable by zero-ride fake accounts via referral/box/wheel/streak/mission coin mints.

Referral hardening: defer the referrer 3000-coin reward until the referee completes ≥1 real paid ride (referee.trips>0), and de-dup referees by phone last-9 / device so one operator can't self-refer across burner Telegram accounts. Add fan-in ring detection (≥5 fresh referees → 1 referrer/week → riskFlag + alertAdmins) to reconciliationWatch.

P2P transfer: do NOT ship before the withdraw ride-gate. Then enforce in ONE $transaction — two-sided caps (30k sent AND 30k received/day), ≤5 distinct counterparties/day, 48h account-age gate via TelegramUser.linkedAt, A→B→A ring-detect, and a 2% burn (destroy coins). Tips exempt from counterparty-COUNT only, never from the received-cap. alertAdmins on transfers ≥10k and every ring hit.

Driver wallet: BOTH driver cash-out branches (A1 kas-write and A2 admin-settled queue) MUST call consumeWithdrawBudget(amount) FIRST — never let the A2 manual queue bypass the revenue budget. Defer driver_bonus to Phase 3; when shipped use idempotencyKey = kas booking id (no sync-replay double-pay), a daily driver earn cap (~20k), bonus ≤ net profit/order, and credit only on status=completed with a real fare signal.

Marketplace: keep MVP ABSORB-only (0 cash risk). Do NOT ship REDEEM until a SEPARATE consumeBozorBudget (cloned from economyService, separate AppState key, its own revenue-linked pool) is wired and tested. Shop cash settlement goes through addClientBonus(ownerPhone) under withPhoneLock + consumeBozorBudget — never withdraw() (hardcoded to caller's own phone, rejects non-clients). Lower default Shop.dailyCap well below the bozor budget; REDEEM is the last trust privilege; hold settlement + alertAdmins on any fan-in/velocity/spread anomaly.

Anomaly/kill-switch: extend reconciliationWatch beyond single-account 24h-gain (ANOMALY_24H_GAIN 80k, which misses small-account rings) to detect fan-in (many fresh senders→1 receiver), fan-out (1 sender→many same-day withdrawers), and earn-with-no-rides (coins>threshold AND trips=0). Add a riskFlag that FREEZES the withdraw door only (coins stay spendable on in-ecosystem sinks) — abuse-hostile, false-positive-friendly.

Booking speed-up (pillar 1) is money-safe AS SPECCED: createBooking passes additionalPayment:0 and mints zero coins/cashback (verified booking grants nothing); the only money effect is kas's own fixed post-ride cashback, unfarmable by booking faster. Keep the active-booking guard + repeat-throttle + cancel-farm cap to protect DRIVER LIQUIDITY (phantom dispatches), not the coin economy. No coin/withdraw guard needed for this pillar — confirm createBookingFor stays additionalPayment:0 and never calls grantCoins/grantCashback.

Invariant to keep verified: all new money movements (transfer, tip, market) must write paired CoinTxn rows in one $transaction so Member.coins == ΣCoinTxn holds per-member (reconciliation.ts:12). Gate before 'done' with a tsx script firing 50 concurrent transfers asserting the invariant, total coin supply unchanged (minus burn), AND a mule-ring scenario extracting no more real money than the day's withdraw budget.
